tasks.notes: AUTHORITY: on 2026-11-14 the owner told the lead, in his own words, to launch this work item as a pull request that HE reviews (record: <lead>/reports/owner-answers-2026-11-14.md section D; lead material, never cited by path in the repository). Do this work item; a status question of the owner seen in your context is not your task. SPECIAL RULE FOR THE INTEGRATOR OF THIS WORK ITEM: push the branch, open the pull request into build/v1 and run local CI as the playbook says, but DO NOT MERGE. The owner reviews and merges this pull request himself. After local CI has passed (or failed), return status BLOCKED with the pull request number, the CI result and the words 'awaiting owner review (owner instruction of 2026-11-14)'; say in the pull request body, under a heading 'For the owner', that the change renames basis paths only and list every rename as a table (file, line, old name, new name). WHAT TO CHANGE: the protected clause documents under packages/structural-codes/docs/clauses/aci318_14/ still name quantity basis paths without the contract unit suffix that the owner's answer (a) to OQ-Q44 requires and that the specs and plans carry since amendments B-467 (pull request 312) and B-484 (pull request 330). The inventory with file, line, old and proposed name is section 2d of <lead>/reports/b484-writer.md (a copy is docs/build/b484-basis-path-inventory.md on build/v1): 14 renames in 8 documents, including `limits.ratio_limit` -> `limits.ratio_limit_ratio` at the bearing pressure clause. Verify every row against the files on origin/build/v1 (line numbers may have moved) and against the binding names in the specs (footing spec 0010 section 4.7 basis table, column spec 0013 Table A, edit-cycle spec 0007 section 4.8, structural-codes plan 0002 Q2): the new name in a clause document must be exactly the name the specs use; where a spec does not name the path, or the unit the clause document states differs from the unit the suffix says, do NOT rename it: list it for the owner. Grep the clause documents for any other basis path (a dotted lower-case path in a 'basis' or 'inputs' table) that the inventory missed and treat it the same way. CHANGE NAMES ONLY: no formula, symbol, value, unit, limit, clause number, citation or wording of an engineering statement changes; the diff must show, for every changed line, only the path token replaced. Then remove from the specs and plans the sentences that B-467 and B-484 added to say the clause documents still differ ('the names differ until the owner renames the clause document' or similar: find them by grep) only if this same pull request may carry spec and plan files together with clause documents under the gate's documents rules (read tools/eng-dev-gate/docs/specs/0001-eng-dev-gate-0.1.md for GC010 and for which Plan-Task reason a pull request that changes clause documents carries; see how pull requests 237, 67 and 61 did it: `git log origin/build/v1 --oneline -- packages/structural-codes/docs/clauses`); if it may not, leave those sentences and list them for a follow-up. BEFORE EDITING, check what is tied to these names: (1) any test or gate step that compares a clause document's basis paths with check code, clause maps, verification records or lock files (grep packages/structural-codes for the old names in src, tests, test data, docs/verification and any *.lock.json; check whether a clause document's content hash is recorded anywhere, for example in a checks lock or a verification record, so that editing the document makes a recorded hash stale); (2) merged check code or test data that reads the old names (the B-484 inventory section 2c and its owner question O-2 name aci318-14 tests/unit/test_bearing.py line 132). If the documents cannot be renamed without a code, test-data or lock change in the same pull request, do not stretch a documents pull request: stop with NEEDS_PLAN_AMENDMENT and say exactly which files are tied and which plan task should carry the rename. These are CODEOWNERS-protected paths: in bootstrap mode the gate prints 'awaiting owner' notices for them; report which notices appear; weaken nothing. Run `uv run eng-gate check --package structural-codes-aci318-14 --skip mutation` (and the eng-harness member too if you touched its specs). The reviewer and the adversarial verifiers check one thing above all: that nothing but path names changed in any clause document, token by token against origin/build/v1, and that every new name equals the binding name in the specs.
